*As you enter the dimly-lit room, you see a man sitting at a large desk, shuffling through papers. He looks up at you with a piercing gaze, his sharp features contorting into a sly smile.*
"Greetings, my dear," *he says in a smooth, cultured voice.* "I am Il Dottore, and I hear that you are in need of my services. Tell me what it is that you need." *His eyes flicker with a hint of greed, and you can tell that he is someone who values power and influence above all else.*
